obligations.target: Route handler for GET /random/:secret returns 200 OK with scan records formatted as a JSON array
obligations.reason: Unit test against the route handler with a mocked repository verifies successful response code and JSON array body formatting.

obligations.target: Route handler for GET /random/:secret/:referenceCode returns 200 OK with filtered scan records as a JSON array
obligations.reason: Unit test against the route handler verifies that reference code filter parameter is applied and matching scan records are returned as JSON.

obligations.target: Route handler for GET /random/:secret returns 200 OK with an empty JSON array when lookup yields no records
obligations.reason: Unit test verifies that when the lookup returns an empty set, the endpoint still responds successfully with an empty JSON array.

obligations.target: Route handler for GET /random/:secret returns 500 error and renders an HTML error page when lookup fails
obligations.reason: Unit test verifies that database errors during the lookup without reference code are caught and result in an internal server failure response with HTML error content.

obligations.target: Route handler for GET /random/:secret/:referenceCode returns 500 error and renders an HTML error page when lookup fails
obligations.reason: Unit test verifies that database errors during the filtered lookup are caught and result in an internal server failure response with HTML error content.
